# Challenge Solution Review

## Objective
Critically challenge a proposed ML/MLOps solution.

## Context
Tech Challenge constraints: PyTorch, DVC (≥3 stages), MLflow, Docker, metrics, reproducibility.

## Instructions
1. What can go wrong? (data, training, deploy)
2. Simpler alternatives?
3. Overengineering risks?
4. Alignment with MovieLens 20M scale

## Output
Risks, alternatives, recommendations
